items.title: CXMT Becomes China's Most Valuable Listed Company After Memory Chipmaker Surges 500% on Debut
items.summary: China’s ChangXin Memory Technologies (CXMT) soared more than 500% in its Shanghai debut on Monday, becoming the country’s most valuable listed company by market capitalization. Asia’s Biggest IPO Delivers Massive Debut Gain CXMT raised 57.92 billion yuan ($8.55 billion) after pricing its IPO at 8.66 yuan ($1.28) per share, making it Asia’s biggest public offering so far this year. items.title: Intel (INTC) Teams With Lens Technology On AI Chip Packaging
items.summary: Intel (NasdaqGS:INTC) has signed a memorandum of understanding with Lens Technology focused on through glass via (TGV) advanced packaging. The collaboration targets next generation AI hardware, including AI PCs, data center chips, embodied AI robotics, and edge computing platforms. The agreement centers on potential joint work in TGV processes and high precision manufacturing to support Intel’s foundry and advanced packaging offerings.
